WITH patient_avgs AS (
  SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) as patient_avg
  FROM Laboratory
  GROUP BY ID
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(patient_avg) as overall_avg
  FROM patient_avgs
  WHERE patient_avg IS NOT NULL
),
kept_patients AS (
  SELECT pa.ID, pa.patient_avg, oa.overall_avg
  FROM patient_avgs pa, overall_avg oa
  WHERE pa.patient_avg > oa.overall_avg
),
kept_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(patient_avg) as kept_avg
  FROM kept_patients
  WHERE patient_avg IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  kp.ID,
  kp.patient_avg,
  kp.patient_avg - kp.overall_avg,
  kp.patient_avg - ka.kept_avg
FROM kept_patients kp, kept_avg ka
WHERE ka.kept_avg IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 
  CASE WHEN (kp.patient_avg - ka.kept_avg) IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  (kp.patient_avg - ka.kept_avg) DESC
LIMIT 10
